description: TimeSeq: a sequencer whose whole behaviour comes from a JSON script loaded through its menu, running any number of timed lanes at once

params.text: Starts a loaded script, or pauses it while it is running
Resets the script to the state it had when it was loaded, clearing its variables and internal triggers, and starts it again if it was running
Sets how fast the script is processed, -10 to 10: above 1 runs that many processing cycles per sample, below -1 runs one cycle every that many samples, and -1, 0 and 1 all run at normal speed
Sets the running time display back to zero without touching the script

inputs.text: A voltage or trigger the script can read, on up to sixteen channels
Starts a loaded script, or pauses it while it is running, on a trigger
Resets the script on a trigger, and starts it again if it was running
Replaces the rate knob while it is patched, the voltage rounded down to a whole number

outputs.text: A voltage the script sets, on up to sixteen channels; a freshly loaded or reset script leaves every output at 0V on one channel
A trigger each time the script's run state changes
A trigger each time the script is reset

notes: the module does nothing at all until a script is loaded from the menu; with none loaded the display reads EMPTY
a script that fails validation is refused and the display reads ERROR; a script that is loaded but not running shows PAUSED
the lamps marked L, S and T blink when a lane loops, a segment starts and an internal trigger fires
the display below the status line draws a line for each output channel the script has set, between -10V and 10V, fading out when the channel stops being updated
menu: Load script... — reads a script from a file
Save script... — writes the loaded script to a file
Copy script — puts the loaded script on the clipboard
Paste script — loads a script from the clipboard, which is the quick way to test an edit
Clear script — removes the loaded script from the module
Copy failed assertions — puts the assertions the running script has failed on the clipboard
